title: Savoy — community news items
text:
Savoy

Cpl Troy McKinney, Camp Livingston, La. is spending a 11 day furlough with his mother, Mrs. Tim Short, before being transferred to Camp Cook, Cal. Pvt. Trueman McKinney, Camp Maxey; and Miss Mary Jesse McKinney,, Dallas have also been guests in the home.

Clarence Rino, of the U. S. Navy, with his wife of Dallas have been visiting his parents Mr. and Mrs. Ernest Rino.

Mr. and Mrs. E. E. Patton and children have returned from Wichita Falls.
notes: Double comma after 'McKinney,,' in original text — preserved verbatim.
